levels.name: First in line
levels.intro: Tap a taxi. If the lane to the edge is clear, it pulls into a bay.

levels.name: After you
levels.intro: Passengers board a matching colour. Full taxis leave. Wrong lane? It hoots.

levels.name: Under the tarp
levels.intro: A tarp hides the colour until a neighbour leaves, or you tap it.

levels.name: Hand brake
levels.intro: Hand brake on. Tap once to release, again to drive.

levels.name: Gaartjie says
levels.intro: The gaartjie jumps the queue onto the first taxi of their colour.

levels.name: Spare key
levels.intro: Grey spares have no passengers. A spare in a bay never leaves.
